packages.address.character: the address holds a character outside printable ASCII: paste it as its git host's Clone button gives it
packages.address.device: the repository's name is a device name on Windows, such as con or nul, which no folder can have
packages.address.driveLetter: a host of one letter is a drive letter to git on Windows: use the host's full name, or an ssh:// address
packages.address.empty: paste the address of a repository, as its git host's Clone button gives it
packages.address.folderCharacter: the repository's name holds a character a package's folder cannot have, such as a space: a package's folder takes letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'
packages.address.host: the host is malformed: labels of letters, digits, '-' and '_' joined by '.'; an IPv6 address is not taken, use the host's name
packages.address.httpsUser: remove the part before '@': your credential helper chooses the account
packages.address.local: a repository on this machine is not taken: clone it in a terminal, or use its git host's address
packages.address.long: the address is over {max, number, ::group-off} characters: paste only the address
packages.address.name: the repository's name is no name of a package's folder: at most 100 letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with neither '.' nor '-'
packages.address.noRepository: the address names no repository: paste the address its git host gives
packages.address.option: an address never starts with '-': paste the address of the repository
packages.address.password: the address holds a password: remove it; your credential helper or your ssh key signs in
packages.address.path: the path of the address is malformed: segments of letters, digits, '.', '_', '~', '+' and '-' joined by '/', none of them '.' or '..' or starting with '-'
packages.address.port: the port is no number from 1 to 65535
packages.address.scheme: only https:// and ssh:// addresses are taken: use the repository's https or ssh address
packages.address.space: paste only the address: it holds white space
packages.address.trailingDot: the repository's name ends with '.', which a folder on Windows cannot keep
packages.address.transport: an address with '::' names a transport of its own, which is not taken: use the repository's https or ssh address
packages.address.user: the user name before '@' is malformed: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter, a digit or '_'
packages.artifacts.none: The package holds no flow, endpoint, mapping or test.

packages.commit.changedOnDisk: A hook changed files you chose on disk

packages.commit.changes.truncated: The commit changes more than {max} files; only the first ones are listed.

packages.commit.note.differs: staged in a terminal with other content: commit or unstage it there

packages.commit.staged: A hook added more files to the commit

packages.commit.unreadBack: git committed, but its commit could not be read back
